private_review_metadata.purpose: Independent multi-turn review specifications, separate from baseline fixtures and candidate implementation tests.
blind_export_rules: Whitelist only public_context, an opaque scenario/turn ID, authorized visible initial context, history, and the current input. Never export expected or private_review_metadata.
Do not expose hidden spouse records, internal ledger details, future user inputs or expected later-turn results to the model.
Keep private expectations in this file and write public prompt packets to a separate file.
Fingerprint public packets and identify provider/model/prompt configuration plus candidate commit.
Preserve multi-turn dependencies. If a fixed oracle prefix supplies prior outcomes in an interpretation-only review, disclose that instead of claiming an end-to-end run.
adapter_contract: All IDs are synthetic stable aliases. Bind generated IDs using bind_created_id_as.
semantic_intent describes behaviour, not a required implementation enum.
backend_outcomes specify resulting records/actions, not raw callable tool arguments. Use current MCP schemas; allow equivalent authorized read sequences. Do not pass outcome-only fields to tools.
spaces is the authorized scope of substantive content. destinations is where substantive replies/notifications may go; generic handoff notices may be separate.
Clarification must not produce the final domain mutation; pending bookkeeping may update while preserving routing and owner.
Unchanged IDs may gain audit/history rows, but domain values must remain unchanged.
Run actions only in disposable databases with fake messaging, fake Home Assistant and a controlled clock. This fixture does not authorize provider or physical-device calls.
Measure exact targets, scope, destinations, mutation counts and clarification counts. Mocks and fixture construction do not demonstrate model accuracy or speed.
Reply content checks are semantic; equivalent natural local date/time/currency formatting is acceptable.
